create-pdf-add-textfragment.title: Create PDF and Add TextFragment
create-pdf-add-textfragment.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF document, add a blank page, insert a TextFragment with custom text, and save the file using Aspose.Pdf.

create-multi-page-pdf-with-text-fragment.title: Create Multi‑Page PDF with Text Fragments
create-multi-page-pdf-with-text-fragment.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add multiple pages, place a TextFragment on each page, and save the document.

set-pdf-centered-window.title: Set PDF to Open with Centered Window
set-pdf-centered-window.description: Loads an existing PDF, enables the CenterWindow flag so the document opens with the viewer window centered, and saves the modified file.

set-pdf-reading-direction-ltr.title: Set PDF Reading Direction to Left-to-Right
set-pdf-reading-direction-ltr.description: Loads a PDF file, changes its reading direction to left‑to‑right, and saves the modified document as a new file.

enable-display-doc-title.title: Enable DisplayDocTitle and Save PDF
enable-display-doc-title.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, sets the DisplayDocTitle flag so PDF viewers show the document title, and saves the updated file as TitleDisplayed.pdf.

set-pdf-open-zoom-150.title: Set PDF Open Zoom to 150% Using XYZExplicitDestination
set-pdf-open-zoom-150.description: Shows how to create a PDF, define an XYZ explicit destination with a 1.5 zoom factor, assign it as the document's OpenAction, and save the result.

extract-zoom-factor-from-openaction.title: Extract Zoom Factor from PDF OpenAction
extract-zoom-factor-from-openaction.description: Loads a PDF, checks its OpenAction for a GoToAction, reads the zoom factor from an XYZ explicit destination, writes the value to a text file, and optionally re‑saves the PDF.

create-pdf-duplex-long-edge.title: Create PDF with Duplex Long Edge Printing
create-pdf-duplex-long-edge.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add simple text, set the duplex printing mode to flip on the long edge, and save the document.

set-pdf-duplex-long-edge.title: Set PDF Duplex Printing Mode to Long Edge
set-pdf-duplex-long-edge.description: The example loads a PDF file, configures its duplex printing mode to flip on the long edge, and saves the modified document.

create-tagged-pdf-with-span-elements.title: Create Tagged PDF with Span Elements for Paragraphs
create-tagged-pdf-with-span-elements.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add paragraphs, and tag each paragraph with a Span element using Aspose.Pdf's Tagged PDF API, then save the document.

set-pdf-window-centering-rtl.title: Set PDF Window Centering and RTL Reading Direction
set-pdf-window-centering-rtl.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, enable CenterWindow, set the document direction to right‑to‑left, and save the result as a new file.

create-pdf-enable-displaydoctitle.title: Create PDF and Enable DisplayDocTitle
create-pdf-enable-displaydoctitle.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF, add a blank page, enable the DisplayDocTitle flag so viewers show the document title, set the title metadata, and save the file.

set-pdf-openaction-zoom-2x.title: Set PDF OpenAction Zoom to 200% Using GoToAction
set-pdf-openaction-zoom-2x.description: Loads a PDF, creates a GoToAction with an XYZExplicitDestination that sets a 2.0 (200%) zoom level, assigns it as the document's OpenAction, and saves the result.

add-tagged-span-to-pdf.title: Add a Tagged Span to a PDF for Accessibility
add-tagged-span-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, enabling tagged content, creating a Span element with accessibility text, attaching it to the document structure, and saving the modified file.

set-duplex-printing-and-center-window.title: Configure Duplex Printing and Center Window in PDF
set-duplex-printing-and-center-window.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set the duplex printing mode to flip on the long edge, enable window centering, and save the modified document.

set-default-zoom-pdf-open-action.title: Set Default Zoom for PDF on Open
set-default-zoom-pdf-open-action.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a page, and set an OpenAction that opens the document at a specific location with a 100% zoom using a GoToAction with XYZExplicitDestination.

disable-pdf-window-title-and-centering.title: Disable PDF Window Title and Centering
disable-pdf-window-title-and-centering.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, turn off the CenterWindow and DisplayDocTitle options, and save the result as a new file.

tag-paragraph-with-span.title: Tag a Paragraph with a Span in a PDF
tag-paragraph-with-span.description: Shows how to load a PDF, use the TaggedContent API to create a paragraph and a span, attach them to the document's structure tree, and save the result as a tagged PDF.

configure-duplex-printing-and-zoom-open-.title: Configure Duplex Printing and Zoom Open Action for a PDF
configure-duplex-printing-and-zoom-open-.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, set the duplex printing mode to flip on the long edge, define an open action that zooms to 125% on the first page, and save the result.

create-pdf-centered-window-title.title: Create PDF with Centered Window and Document Title
create-pdf-centered-window-title.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF, add a blank page, set the window to open centered and display the document title in the title bar, and save the file.

set-pdf-openaction-zoom-75.title: Set PDF OpenAction Zoom to 75%
set-pdf-openaction-zoom-75.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, assign a GoToAction as the document's OpenAction with a 75% zoom using XYZExplicitDestination, and save the modified file.

create-rtl-tagged-pdf-with-span.title: Create RTL Tagged PDF with Span Element
create-rtl-tagged-pdf-with-span.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF with right‑to‑left reading direction, add Arabic text, and use the tagged‑content API to insert a Span element (BDC/EMC operators) for accessibility.

create-pdf-set-open-zoom-180.title: Create PDF and Set Open Action Zoom to 180%
create-pdf-set-open-zoom-180.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a page with text, set the document's OpenAction to a 1.8 (180%) zoom using XYZExplicitDestination, and save the file.

set-pdf-center-window-and-duplex.title: Set PDF Viewer Center Window and Duplex Printing Mode
set-pdf-center-window-and-duplex.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, enable the CenterWindow option so the viewer opens centered, set the duplex printing mode to flip long edge, and save the modified document.

set-rtl-direction-and-display-title.title: Set PDF Reading Direction to RTL and Display Document Title
set-rtl-direction-and-display-title.description: The example loads an existing PDF, changes its reading direction to right‑to‑left, enables the document title to be shown in the viewer, and saves the result as RTLTitle.pdf.

set-pdf-openaction-zoom-2-5.title: Set PDF OpenAction Zoom Level Using GoToAction
set-pdf-openaction-zoom-2-5.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, assign an OpenAction with a GoToAction that uses an XYZ explicit destination to set the initial zoom factor to 2.5, and save the result.

create-pdf-centered-window-ltr.title: Create PDF with Centered Viewer Window and LTR Direction
create-pdf-centered-window-ltr.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a blank page, set the viewer window to open centered, specify left‑to‑right reading direction, and save the document.

create-tagged-pdf-with-zoomed-openaction.title: Create Tagged PDF with Zoomed OpenAction
create-tagged-pdf-with-zoomed-openaction.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF, add a tagged Span element, set the document language, and define an OpenAction that opens the first page at 130% zoom.

set-zoom-and-hide-doc-title.title: Set PDF OpenAction Zoom and Hide Document Title
set-zoom-and-hide-doc-title.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, set an OpenAction with a 100% zoom using a GoToAction, disable the display of the document title, and save the result.

set-pdf-fullscreen-mode.title: Set PDF to Open in Full‑Screen Mode
set-pdf-fullscreen-mode.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, setting the document's PageMode to FullScreen, and saving the modified file.
